abilities.name: lightning-rod
abilities.effect: Redirects single-target electric moves to this Pokémon where possible.  Absorbs Electric moves, raising Special Attack one stage.

abilities.name: reckless
abilities.effect: Strengthens recoil moves to 1.2× their power.

kanto.flavorText: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. Its TACKLE can knock a semitrailer flying.

original-johto.flavorText: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.

hoenn.flavorText: Once it starts running, it doesn’t stop. Its tiny brain makes it so stupid that it can’t remember why it started running in the first place.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Its body is clad in a thick hide, and its tackles topple buildings. Unfortunately, it is not smart.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.

updated-johto.flavorText: It doesn’t care if there is anything in its way. It just charges and destroys all obstacles.

original-unova.flavorText: Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.

updated-unova.flavorText: Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.

kalos.flavorText: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Rhyhorn’s brain is very small. It is so dense, while on a run it forgets why it started running in the first place. It apparently remembers sometimes if it demolishes something.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: A Pokémon with a one-track mind. Once it charges, it won’t stop running until it falls asleep.

swsh.flavorText: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.

pla.flavorText: Ludicrously strong—when it butts heads with a mountain, it is the mountain that shatters. But its short legs struggle with turns, and it is incapable of stopping unless it collides with something.
